$(AA^t)_{ij} = \sum_k a_{ik} a_{jk}$
$(A^t A)_{ij} = \sum_k a_{ki} a_{kj}$

So the condition is: $\sum_k a_{ik} a_{jk} = \sum_k a_{ki} a_{kj}$ for all $i,j$.

This is a system of quadratic equations. We want the maximum dimension of a linear subspace contained in this variety.
